monitor: M2, L2 logistic regression on the one-scale residual stream
score: ((h - mu) / sc) @ coef + intercept; flag when score >= trigger
h: output of decoder layer `layer` (0-based) at the last token before the agent's reply, bfloat16 read
preprocessing: mu: mean of the 1,710 training states; sc: each dimension's spread with states centred within experiment x condition x request, plus 1e-6

training.experiments: A, B, C, C2, D, E, F (rd2-states v2/<exp>_bf16)
training.label: joined (trade measure)

selection.procedure: 5-fold cross-validation grouped by career on all 1,710 requests, seed 20261106
